record.edic_text:
1825 exegeiro {ex-eg-i'-ro}

from 1537 and 1453; TDNT - 2:338,195; v

AV - raise up 2; 2

1) to arouse, raise up (from sleep)
2) to rouse up, stir up, incite

same.cexp: 完全甦醒或保持清醒（#路 9:32|）
使（死人）復活；興起；＜不及＞起來！
